title: Full Stack Integration
description: Full-stack integration of React frontend with Node.js/Express backend, covering authentication, CRUD operations, forms, validation, file uploads, and database integration.
learning_outcomes: Build full-stack applications with React and Node.js
Implement RESTful API communication between frontend and backend
Manage application state with React hooks and context
Implement secure authentication and authorization flows
Handle file uploads and form validation
Integrate databases with proper error handling
